verses.1: Do not look at your brothers’ graves, nor at those who are rejected by God. Return them to your brothers.
verses.2: And if your brother comes to you, but you don’t know him, and you bring him inside your house, then he shall stay with you until your brother returns. Then you can put him back in his place.
verses.3: And you shall do the same with his armor; and you shall also do the same with his cloak. And you shall do the same with every one of your brothers who perish from us. Once they are lost, they cannot be recovered.
verses.4: Do not look at your brothers’ graves or at those who fall along the way. Stay away from them; do not get involved with them.
verses.5: There shall be no marriage between a man and a woman. Nor shall a man wear a woman’s clothing, because this is an act of disobedience to the LORD your God. All such things are forbidden.
verses.6: For when the “Camp of Stars” is mentioned before you, in every tree or on the earth, there will be blossoms or eggs. And if a mother bird sits on those blossoms or eggs, she should not take any of the chicks from them.
verses.7: Send the mother and the children away; take them with you, so that it will be good for you, and you may live long lives.
verses.8: For if you build a new house and prepare the roof for it, yet do not put up flowers in your house, so that those who fall from there may not die.
verses.9: Do not sow your vineyard with worthless seeds, so that the seed sown may not become holy.
verses.10: Do not sleep in the same room with him.
verses.11: Do not mix leather with cotton together.
verses.12: May it be that you are raised up by four wings, just as your covering will cover you.
verses.13: For a man takes a woman, and comes to her, and loves her.
verses.14: And he gave her evil names, and gave her a bad reputation. He said, “I’ve taken this woman; I’ll go to her.” But I couldn’t find any daughters for her.
verses.15: And my father took the young girl and her mother, and they brought her before the elders of the city.
verses.16: And the young woman’s father said to the elders, “I have given my daughter to this man as a wife.” And they hated her.
verses.17: And behold, he put up signs saying, “I did not find any daughters among your daughters.” And these were the daughters of my wife. Then he spread out the cloth in front of the elders of the city.
verses.18: And the elders of that city took the man and banished him.
verses.19: And they punished him by imposing a fine of one hundred silver coins. They also gave this fine to my mother, because she had brought harm upon Israel’s women. She could not send her daughter away from there for the rest of her life.
verses.20: And if this were true, then it wouldn’t have been found in the records of the youth.
verses.21: And they brought the girl to the door of her father’s house. Then the people of her city stoneed her to death. She died because she was a witch in Israel, who caused trouble in her father’s house and in the city.
verses.22: For someone was found lying with a woman in the bed of a man. Both of them died. The man who lay with the woman, and the woman, both died in the evil city of Israel.
verses.23: For there will be a young girl who is captured by a man, and she will be found in the city. Then a man will sleep with her.
verses.24: And you brought them out both to the gate of that city. Then you covered them with stones. The young girl died because she didn’t cry in the city. And the man died because he betrayed his wife. In that evil city, from afar away…
verses.25: And if, in the field, a man finds a young girl who has been stolen from her family, and he holds her in his arms and lies with her, then the man who lies with her will die alone.
verses.26: And a young man shall not do such a thing. A young man has no right to commit murder. For when one person rises against another and kills him, it is a grave sin.
verses.27: For in the field, she found a young girl who was crying. And there was no one to save her.
verses.28: For someone found a girl hanging from a tree, who had not been hanged before. He rescued her and lay down with her; and they were found together.
verses.29: And the man who was with her gave her fifty pieces of silver. She became a woman under his control, but he couldn’t send her away from there all day long.
